# Dispatched owner inputs

A dispatched `[ARIADNE_INPUT:<input>:<attempt>]` carries `source_input_id`,
`attempt_id`, `binding_id`, `generation`, `owner_message_number`, `input_kind`,
target `item_id`, `item_revision`, `question_revision` or `topic_id`, optional
`selected_option_id`/`selected_option_label`, and exact owner `text`. Read the
item/history with the CLI; keep host permissions.

## Choice notes

The option note wins over its consequence. Follow `SKILL.md` for free-text
interpretation, ambiguity and ripple updates.

## Answering

Copy envelope ids; commit one `input_result`:

- `outcome`: `answered`, `deferred` or `unable`.
- `explanation`: what you did.
- `reply_refs`: this request's reply `ref`s, never existing ids. Omit if none.
- `followup_item_refs`: new items for this input, by `ref`; omit if none.
- `handled_through_message_number`: the envelope's `owner_message_number`.

Host completion is not a result. Answer with `reply`; chat points there.
Deletion cancels queued inputs only; claimed inputs/removal notices stay valid. After “Stop waiting” for a missing result, save it with the
same envelope ids; cancellation, removed work, a new generation or a resend
reject that old answer.

## Input kinds

- `answer`: act on the choice and note on `item_id`, ripple updates (`SKILL.md`),
  and finish its parent for Ack if this was its last open child.
- `reply`, `note`, `followup`: owner text; see `follow-up.md`.
- `bring`: raise `item_id` with `item.ask` and options.
- `reopen`, `drop`: reopen or drop `item_id`, with a reply that says why.
  Drop or “close it” permits terminal `item.status` with `source_input_id`,
  even with `ack_to`; Dropped stays in the tree. Existing work without `ack_to`
  can close normally; unanswered asks kept open stay `waiting_on_me`.
- `continue`: earlier work continues into `topic_id`; `text` is the handoff
  summary. Read that topic's items before working.
- `topic_reply`: an instruction for the whole topic; see `follow-up.md`.
- `removed`: stop work on `removed.refs`; never mention/recreate them or touch
  files because of removal. No operations; outcome `answered`.

`"purpose":"result_repair"`: follow `errors.md` before writing.

Finish parents per `checklist.md`.

## Examples

Answer [owner choice](item:1): "Cap retries at three" overrides five attempts.
Update [retry cap](item:1.1) and [retry budget](item:3) together.
